description: Sample Hybrid Wind-Photovoltaic Energy System Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Md. Ashaduzzaman Niloy. This dataset contains:Hourly load demand of a typical single residence in Pacific Northwest, USA.Hourly average incoming solar radiation and generated power from a single photovoltaic cell placed in Pacific Northwest, USA.Hourly wind profile and generated power from a single wind turbine placed in Pacific Northwest, USAThis dataset was originally formulated by Kellogg et al. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
